content.text:
This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations. Its caption: "FIGURE 9-2. THE 3-POINT SINGLE HARNESS POSITIONING".
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows a line drawing of a seated person wearing a three-point single harness, with a diagonal shoulder strap running from the left shoulder down to the right hip and a lap belt across the waist.

There are no labels, values, units, part numbers, or notes printed in the figure.
